claim: For every finite r,s>=1, fixed finite k_ji>=1, and fixed strictly positive finite rate vector in the complete-pair network family defined in leaves/exponential_foster_outside_gain/RESULT.txt, the standard stochastic mass-action CTMC on N_0^(r+s) is irreducible, nonexplosive in physical time, and positive recurrent.
proof_object: Exact generator and finite-set drift proof in leaves/exponential_foster_outside_gain/RESULT.txt, Sections 1-3. The Lyapunov function is linear in catalysts, exponential in substrates, and has an additive indicator on A=0. The physical-time nonexplosion argument uses localized stopped Dynkin before applying a CTMC Foster criterion.
assumptions: Every catalyst-substrate pair has both displayed reversible substrate and autocatalytic reaction pairs.
All rate constants are strictly positive and finite.
class: The full nonnegative integer lattice is one closed irreducible class, with stoichiometric rank r+s.
limits: Pointwise in rates. No stationary exponential moment, uniform parameter tightness, uniform mixing, or general weakly reversible recurrence is claimed by this proof alone.

source.citation: D. F. Anderson and J. Kim, Some network conditions for positive recurrence of stochastically modeled reaction networks, arXiv:1710.11263v3 (2018), Theorem 3.1.
source.use: The continuous-time Foster recurrence criterion only; nonexplosion is separately proved in the artifact.

novelty: UNKNOWN; no priority claim or external review.

claim: For each fixed finite complete-pair network structure and each compact rate box whose lower endpoints are strictly positive, there exist one R>1 and constants C,c>0, independent of the selected rate vector in the box, such that V=A+(1+1_{A=0})sum_i R^b_i satisfies L_theta V<=C-cV for all states and all rates in the box. The invariant laws are uniformly tight and have a uniformly bounded R-exponential moment for every substrate coordinate and a uniformly bounded first moment for total catalyst count.
proof_object: Full exact generator and uniform threshold proof in leaves/geometric_rate_box.txt. Choose R with delta_min^- - s p_max^+(R-1)>0; q_min>0 gives uniform exponential substrate domination; on bounded substrate vectors the zero-substrate death margin and positive-substrate reverse factorial terms control catalyst growth. Localized physical-time Dynkin gives nonexplosion; time-averaged occupation measures and the common drift yield the invariant moment bound.
assumptions: Fixed finite r,s and finite k_ji>=1.
Each rate varies in a compact interval bounded away from zero and infinity.
Complete catalyst-substrate interaction and all four positive paired reactions per pair.
limits: No uniform mixing-time bound is claimed. No assertion holds for boxes approaching zero rates, unbounded rate sets, sparse support, or general weakly reversible networks.

source.citation: I. Kontoyiannis and S. P. Meyn, On the f-Norm Ergodicity of Markov Processes in Continuous Time, arXiv:1512.00523 (2015), Theorem 1.1.
source.use: Abstract nonexplosive extended-generator drift implication for finite invariant f-moment; the network-specific drift is proved in the artifact.

claim: The r=1,s=2,k_1i=1 rates alpha=delta=p_i=1,q_i=2,u_i=1,v_i=2 define a full-rank weakly reversible but non-complex-balanced CTMC outside the strict linear small-gain region; it is positive recurrent by the complete-pair theorem.
proof_object: The LP inequalities imply lambda>w_1+w_2 and w_i>lambda/2 for both i, a contradiction. Complex balance would require a=1 at the 0/A pair and a=1/2 at each 2A+B_i/A+B_i pair. The exact Foster witness is recorded in leaves/exponential_foster_outside_gain/RESULT.txt, Section 4.
limits: Failure of the LP is shown not to imply nonrecurrence for this family. This is not a transient, null-recurrent, or explosive example; the stationary law is not computed in closed form.

claim: The support-corrected exponential Lyapunov function in leaves/exponential_foster_outside_gain/SPARSE_EXTENSION.txt proves positive recurrence of each communicating class for the stated finite sparse paired-edge family with positive immigration/death and positive paired reactions on each edge.
limits: The proof has a more delicate mixed-escape and last-neighbor switching argument than the complete-pair theorem; its finite checker checks only the generator identity. Treat as separate and pending independent proof review. Isolated substrate counts label the communicating classes.

claim: Exact Fraction scripts verify the multiplicative-corrector generator on a 4096-state fixture grid, the additive witness on 4096 states and its outside-F drift on 20656 grid states, the sparse switch generator on 4096 states, and strict-LP primal/dual examples.
limits: Finite arithmetic checks are diagnostics, not formal proof checking, external verification, novelty evidence, or an all-state Foster argument.

claim: The one-linkage weakly reversible deterministic ODE family is covered by the permanence theorem audited in leaves/deterministic_permanence.txt.
limits: This deterministic result is not used to infer stochastic CTMC recurrence; falling-factorial jump propensities and physical holding times are handled separately.

claim: No general recurrence theorem or rigorously classified transient/null-recurrent/explosive counterexample for arbitrary higher-dimensional weakly reversible mass-action CTMCs was obtained in this cycle.
reason: The audited published sufficient criteria leave a reachable boundary tier outside their hypotheses; failure of those criteria does not imply nonrecurrence. The reported 2D all-rate theorem remains source-reported in the checked materials.
